items.headline: Stocks Under Pressure as Bond Yields Soar and Oil Prices Climb
items.summary: U.S. stocks continued their decline on Thursday, extending losses from Wednesday, as surging Treasury yields, rising crude oil prices, and heightened expectations for further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes pressured equities. The S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow Jones Industrial Average all registered losses during midday trading, amidst growing concerns over inflation and a bond market sell-off. Market breadth has deteriorated, signaling increasing risks of a broader correction.

items.headline: Everpure (P) Soars on Positive Fiscal Outlook
items.summary: The data-storage company Everpure ($P) saw its stock surge after reaffirming its fiscal 2027 guidance and projecting accelerated revenue growth for fiscal 2028.

items.headline: Charles River Labs (CRL) Jumps After Investor Day
items.summary: Charles River Laboratories International ($CRL) experienced a significant gain following its 2026 Investor Day, where the life sciences company presented a refreshed strategic framework and raised its near-term financial outlook.

items.headline: Stitch Fix (SFIX) Tumbles on Challenging Consumer Environment Forecast
items.summary: Despite reporting better-than-expected quarterly results, Stitch Fix's stock ($SFIX) plummeted after the company warned of a "more challenging consumer environment" that could hinder its revenue growth in the upcoming fiscal year.

items.headline: Oracle (ORCL) Falls on Force Majeure Declaration
items.summary: Oracle's shares ($ORCL) declined sharply following reports that the company invoked a force majeure related to a New Mexico data center project, sparking investor concerns about potential delays and increased expenses.

items.headline: Robust Economic Data Fuels Rate Hike Expectations
items.summary: Strong U.S. business activity data, reporting the fastest growth in years, alongside a drop in unemployment claims, has strengthened expectations that the Federal Reserve will implement further interest rate hikes. Markets are now pricing in a 66% chance of a quarter percentage point hike in October.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Climb to Multi-Year Highs
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield surged to 5.16% on Thursday, marking its highest level since July 2007, while the 30-year yield also reached its highest point since 2004. These elevated bond yields are increasing borrowing costs and contributing to the downward pressure on equity markets.

items.headline: Oil Prices Surge Amid Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: Crude oil prices continued their ascent, with Brent Crude futures rising to $107.24 per barrel, up 4.0%. The increase is attributed to ongoing Middle East tensions and concerns over Iran's stance against international pressure, rekindling inflation fears across markets.

items.headline: Technology and Basic Materials Lag, Energy and Communication Services Lead
items.summary: On Thursday, the technology and basic materials sectors were notable laggards, with 126 out of 150 priced US stocks in the technology sector experiencing declines. Conversely, energy and communication services showed the biggest gains.

items.headline: Investors Eye Trump-Xi Summit Amid Trade and AI Discussions
items.summary: Investors are closely monitoring a high-stakes summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping. Discussions are expected to cover contentious issues including trade, technological competition in AI, and Beijing's support for Tehran, with a trade truce recently extended until January 2027.
